signIn.title: Welcome back
signIn.body: Sign in to pick up where the team left off.
signIn.bodyReturning: You'll go straight back to where you were.
signIn.remember: Keep me signed in on this device
signIn.unreachable: We couldn't reach sign-in just now. Try again.
signIn.footnote: New here? Ask your workspace admin for an invitation.

error.expired: That sign-in attempt expired. Start again.
error.exchange_failed: We couldn't complete sign-in. Try again.

sessionExpired.title: You've been signed out
sessionExpired.body: Your session ended. Sign in again to pick up where you left off.

scale.headline: Three hundred and forty people are mid-conversation with a customer.
scale.support: GOTCHA has answered 41,800 messages since midnight - 88% of them without anyone reading them first.

actions.headline: Nine hundred and twelve orders were tracked, changed or refunded without a person.
actions.support: Every one of them left a trace you can open, read and undo.

team.headline: Everything GOTCHA does is written down.
team.support: Which tool it used, on whose behalf, and when - on one page, in plain words.

why.headline: A refund is real money. So is a customer list.
why.support: Everyone who can act on a customer's behalf signs in twice. It costs a few seconds, and it is the reason an admin can sleep.

behind.headline: The actions behind this code can move money.
behind.support: Refunds, cancellations, discounts, payout details. All of them are one code away, and every use of them is logged.

cost.headline: A few seconds, rarely.
cost.support: This device stays trusted, so this is not a code you will be asked for often.

secondFactor.status: Two-step is required by your workspace

secondFactor.title: One more step
secondFactor.continuing: Taking you to your sign-in provider.

code.label: Code from your authenticator app
code.hint: It submits itself the moment the last digit lands.

recovery.label: Recovery code
recovery.hint: One of the codes you saved when you set up two-step.

method.webauthn: Use your security key - continues at your sign-in provider
method.duo: Approve with Duo - continues at your sign-in provider
method.sms: Get a code by SMS - continues at your sign-in provider
method.other: Another method - continues at your sign-in provider

recover.title: Reset your password
recover.lede: Enter the address you sign in with and we will send you a link to set a new password.
recover.unreachable: We could not reach the sign-in service. Try once more.

editorial.headline: A password is the one thing we cannot tell you.
editorial.support: We can only send a link to the address already on the account. Nobody here can read your password, and nobody can set one for you.

recover.sentBody: If {email} has an account here, a link to set a new password is on its way. It expires shortly, so use it soon.
